summary: ProText Mobility, an OTC Pink/OTCID-listed former SEC reporting company, voluntarily filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to introduce into EDGAR a GlobeNewswire press release originally published 2026-10-13. The release confirms the Chairman's ownership of 831.3 million common shares, reaffirms zero preferred-share conversions, and restates management's long-term ownership philosophy and institutional-readiness objectives, framed as preparation for a potential national exchange uplisting. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing creates no change of control or capital-structure event; the arbitrage angle is nil, with attention only on uplisting progress and future share-count or preferred-conversion disclosures.
